notes: «أن يحيى بن سعيد، وإسماعيل بن إبراهيم، حدثاهم» names two co-transmitters who share one level, the dual verb making both transmit to Musaddad
«- المعنى -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«عن أبيه» is a relation with no name: the father of Abu al-Malih is not named in the text and is not filled
